text:
emma_fin: Noticed a weekend jump in GPU charges (~$6.4k) in the billing export, none of the top rows have team labels. Can someone triage?

billing-bot: Alert: Unlabeled GPU spend detected (+$6,387) on 2026-01-25 04:18 UTC. Auto-ticket FIN-778 created.

jack_ops: Looking quickly at the BQ export, many VM names look like `dev-*` and some have label keys but empty values. Query I used: ```sql
SELECT instance_name, labels, cost, zone FROM `billing.gcp_daily` WHERE date = '2026-01-25' AND product='Compute Engine' ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 50;
```

alex_payne: I saw that too. Most of these were launched from the nonprod autoscaler pool (autoscale-group: experiments). The startup-image version deployed on friday doesn't apply allocation_label if the metadata service is slow.

nora_sre: We had a short metadata outage in us-central1 on the 25th around 03:50 UTC — correlates with the timing. That explains missing labels. SRE is adding a retry to the metadata fetch in the init script to avoid empty labels.

emma_fin: For bookkeeping, finance prefers to pro-rate these back to teams if we can map them by owner or project id. If not, we'll attribute to `infra-unallocated` for month-end but would like an estimate beforehand.

jack_ops: I can run a retro active join using instance creation records (operation logs) and project IAM bindings to guess owners. Pseudocode: ```sql
-- match instances to creating user via audit logs
SELECT i.instance_id, a.actor, i.cost FROM `gcp.compute.instances` i JOIN `gcp.audit.logs` a ON i.create_op = a.operation_id WHERE date = '2026-01-25';
```
I'll produce a CSV with best-effort owner mapping.

alex_payne: If owner mapping fails for some, can we fallback to pro-rate across projects by total gpu_hours? Also need to check whether reserved commit capacity should absorb some of the cost before pro-rating.

emma_fin: Yes: waterfall we want: 1) reserved commit consumption, 2) map to team/project where evidence exists, 3) pro-rate residual by gpu_hours among active projects in the billing period. Also reconcile any vendor promo credits that might have been misapplied to the pool.

nora_sre: I'll attach the metadata outage incident notes to FIN-778 so Finance has the root cause. Also adding the fix PR: https://git.redwood.ai/sre/startup-scripts/pull/203 — sets LABEL_KEY with retries and exponential backoff.

jack_ops: Temp mitigation: I patched the autoscaler to prefer images that include the updated init script. New launches should have labels set. Retrobackfill will run in the morning and I expect a provisional allocation table by EOD Monday.

emma_fin: Please mark FIN-778 as "provisional-assign: nonprod-lab" for dashboards so alerts don't trigger. We'll accept provisional assignment for reporting, but we need the final backfill CSV and the audit logs used to justify reclassification.

billing-bot: FIN-778 status updated: provisional assignment set to 'nonprod-lab'. Recheck scheduled every 2 hours.

emma_fin: Thx. Once jack posts the CSV, I'll re-run the monthly allocation script and push an adjusted forecast to the monthly close board. If anything else pops during the weekend ping me directly. :pray:
